title: NY State Assembly · District 77
area: The West Bronx, including Highbridge and surrounding neighborhoods.

context.text: Uncontested race. Incumbent Landon Dais advanced from the Democratic primary unopposed after Shakur Joseph withdrew or was disqualified; no Republican candidate qualified for the general-election ballot.

candidates.name: Landon Dais
candidates.currentRole: NY State Assembly Member, District 77 (since February 2024)

priorities.text: Economic development, investing in youth, access to healthcare, vocational training, and immigration.

record.text: Assembly committee assignments for 2025-2026: Banks, Cities, Economic Development/Job Creation/Commerce and Industry, Energy, Housing, and Small Business.
Won a February 13, 2024 special election to the Assembly, succeeding Latoya Joyner.

sources.title: Landon Dais for NY Assembly — District 77

researchNotes: No opposing candidate qualified for the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot in this district. Dais has not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey; his campaign site's Issues page states specific positions on healthcare and immigration, documented above, but its other listed priority topics (affordable housing, street safety, seniors, vocational training) remain general statements without a stance matching this guide's fixed issue list. Dais's biography relies on his official Assembly page, his campaign site and Ballotpedia; no independent news profile was loaded.
